focus: 用交換條件說不，不用得罪人
lead: 今天練的是拒絕與協商：有人要塞需求進來、或壓一個做不到的日期，你要能把話擋回去又不傷關係。核心心法只有一句 —— 不要直接說 no，改成「可以，但要換掉什麼」。每個 speaking 段落請先出聲講完再看解答。

phrases.en: Happy to take that on — here's what it displaces.
phrases.gl: 我可以接，但你要知道它會擠掉什麼（把拒絕變成交換）
phrases.ex: Happy to take the rain dataset on — here's what it displaces: the tunnel GNSS runs move to October.

phrases.en: That's a yes-if, not a no.
phrases.gl: 這不是拒絕，是有條件的答應（非常好用的軟化開場）
phrases.ex: That's a yes-if, not a no — yes if we get a third test vehicle slot from the vehicle team.

phrases.en: We can protect the date or the scope — not both.
phrases.gl: 日期跟範圍只能保一個（把選擇權丟回給對方）
phrases.ex: We can protect the September date or the rear fisheye — not both. Which one matters more to your customer?

phrases.en: What would you have us drop to make room for that?
phrases.gl: 那要拿掉什麼來換？（不用自己說不，讓對方面對排擠效應）
phrases.ex: What would you have us drop to make room for that — the night set or the labeling backlog?

phrases.en: Let me push back on the timeline, not the goal.
phrases.gl: 我反對的是時程，不是這件事本身（先站到對方那一邊）
phrases.ex: Let me push back on the timeline, not the goal — I want the fisheye data too, just not inside this cycle.

phrases.en: Help me understand what's driving the date.
phrases.gl: 這個日期是怎麼來的？（不是質疑，是找出真正的限制）
phrases.ex: Help me understand what's driving the 15th — is that a customer commitment or an internal target?

phrases.en: I'd rather commit to less and hit it.
phrases.gl: 我寧可承諾少一點但做到（把保守講成專業，而不是消極）
phrases.ex: I'd rather commit to two scenarios and hit them than promise five and deliver four.

phrases.en: Where I see it differently is…
phrases.gl: 我看法不同的地方在於 ——（有立場，但對事不對人）
phrases.ex: Where I see it differently is the labeling capacity — the vendor queue is already three weeks deep.
phrases.fix: 取代 "I don't agree your plan"

phrases.en: That's not something I can commit to this cycle.
phrases.gl: 這個週期我沒辦法承諾（乾淨的拒絕，不留假希望）
phrases.ex: That's not something I can commit to this cycle, but I can scope it properly for the next one.
phrases.fix: 取代 "Maybe it's a little bit difficult, we will try our best"

setup: Setup. It's the Wednesday scope review for the September data delivery. Grace, from the customer program office, wants two things added without moving the date: a rainy-night dataset, and a new rear fisheye camera position on the test vehicles. Your reality is that the labeling vendor's queue is already three weeks deep, you only get two test vehicle slots a week, and adding a fisheye position means re-running extrinsic calibration on all four cars. Separately, Alan wants 20k old frames re-labeled with a revised taxonomy. Everyone is being reasonable, and nobody is going to back off on their own.

prompts.q: Grace: “We'd like to add the rainy-night set and the rear fisheye to the September delivery. The date stays the 15th.”
prompts.frame: Show you want it too → name the hard constraint with a number → offer the trade explicitly → hand the choice back.
prompts.say: 先出聲講完整段（目標 40 秒），不要用 “maybe” 開場，再看 model answer。
prompts.model: “I want both of those in the dataset, so let me push back on the timing rather than the ask. Two hard constraints: the labeling vendor is three weeks deep right now, and adding a rear fisheye means re-running extrinsics on all four cars — that's about a week of vehicle time we don't have spare. So it's a yes-if, not a no. If the 15th is fixed, I can deliver the rainy-night set on time and move the fisheye to the October drop. If the fisheye has to be in September, the delivery moves to roughly the 29th. Which of those two works better for your customer?”

prompts.q: Grace: “Can't the vendor just expedite? Or the team pushes a bit harder this month?”
prompts.frame: Take the question seriously → show you already checked → explain the real cost of forcing it → offer the one thing that would actually help.
prompts.say: 出聲練習「擋掉加壓」，語氣平穩，不要用道歉開場。
prompts.model: “I did ask them on Monday. They can expedite about 5k frames at roughly double the rate, and honestly the bigger risk is quality — last time we rushed a batch we spent two weeks cleaning up mislabeled cut-ins, so we lost the time anyway. On pushing the team: they've been running weekend collection slots for three weeks straight, and I'd rather not spend that goodwill on a scope add. What would actually move the needle is a third test vehicle slot. If you can get that from the vehicle team, I'll revisit the date with you on Friday.”

prompts.q: Alan, right after the meeting: “While you're at it, can you get the 20k old frames re-labeled with the new taxonomy?” You have to say no.
prompts.frame: Agree it's the right thing to do → say no clearly for this cycle → give a reason that isn't “I'm busy” → offer a smaller real alternative with a date.
prompts.say: 出聲講一次乾脆的拒絕 —— 不准說 "I will try my best"。
prompts.model: “It's the right call eventually — the old taxonomy is going to bite us at some point. But that's not something I can commit to this cycle. The queue is fully allocated to September, and re-labeling 20k frames would push the delivery by about two weeks on its own. Here's what I can do: pick the 2k frames that matter most for cut-in evaluation and I'll get those into the September batch, so we can at least see whether the new taxonomy changes the numbers. Send me the frame IDs by Friday and I'll confirm it Monday.”

fixes.bad: We only have two test vehicle slot next week, so is impossible.
fixes.good: We only have two test vehicle slots next week, so that's not feasible.
fixes.note: Plurals + missing subject：可數名詞要加 s（slots）；英文句子不能沒有主詞，"so is impossible" 要說成 "so that's not…"。另外 impossible 太滿，not feasible 留了討論空間。

fixes.bad: I don't agree your plan, it's too aggressive.
fixes.good: Where I see it differently is the timeline — it's more aggressive than our labeling capacity can support.
fixes.note: Preposition + register：agree 後面要接 with；而且 "I don't agree your plan" 是在否定對方這個人。換成「我看法不同的地方在於……」才是對事不對人。

fixes.bad: If we will add the fisheye camera, the schedule will delay two weeks.
fixes.good: If we add the fisheye camera, the schedule will slip by two weeks.
fixes.note: Conditional + voice：if 子句用現在式，不加 will；schedule 是被延後，要說 slip 或 be delayed，不能說 schedule will delay。

fixes.bad: Maybe it's a little bit difficult for us, but we will try our best.
fixes.good: That's not something I can commit to this cycle. What I can do is deliver the 2k priority frames by the 15th.
fixes.note: Vague hedging：這句在中文語境是禮貌的拒絕，但英文母語者會直接理解成「他答應了」。含糊答應之後跳票，傷害遠大於一開始說不。

fixes.bad: This is not my responsible, you should ask to the vehicle team.
fixes.good: That one sits with the vehicle team — want me to loop Kevin in?
fixes.note: Word form + preposition + register：responsible 是形容詞，名詞是 responsibility；ask 後面不加 to。直接把球踢走會顯得推卸，順手幫忙接上線，立場一樣但關係保住了。

challenge:
今天在真實會議中做這一件事：當有人要塞需求給你，不要說 yes 也不要說 no，改用這個句型 ——

“Happy to take that on — here's what it displaces: ___. We can protect ___ or ___, not both. Which matters more to you?”

錄音作業（60 秒，手機錄）：挑一件這週真的有人請你多做的事，用英文練習拒絕它。

  • 必須出現一個具體數字（幾天、幾張圖、幾台車）
  • 必須提出一個較小的替代方案，而且附上日期
  • 禁用：maybe、a little bit difficult、try our best、sorry for the inconvenience
check: 今天我有沒有把一次「拒絕」講成「交換條件」，而不是硬說 no 或勉強答應？
我有沒有一次都沒用到 “maybe”、“a little bit difficult”、“try our best”？
我說不的時候，有沒有同時給出一個更小、但有明確日期的替代方案？
